name: Colorado River — State Bridge to Dotsero
gaugeName: Colorado River at Catamount Bridge, CO (USGS 09060799)
blurb: Mostly Class I–II canyon floating along the Colorado River Road between Eagle County and BLM ramps from State Bridge to Dotsero Landing.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Hazardous bridges just above Two Bridges over 5,500 cfs (BLM). Mileage: BLM Upper Colorado River Guide (Pumphouse to Dotsero), 2015.
